```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)
library(vars)
library(urca)
library(tseries)
library(plotly)

# Paleta Corporativa Unificada (Curriculum.pdf — Executive Navy & Champagne Gold)
jbz_cv_palette <- c(
  navy = "#0B1B33", plot_navy = "#102342", elev_navy = "#163259",
  cobalt = "#1D4ED8", sky = "#38BDF8", gold = "#B8955A",
  gold_soft = "#D9C29A", emerald = "#10B981", rose = "#F43F5E",
  mist = "#C7D2E3", white = "#FFFFFF"
)
jbz_series_colors <- c("#38BDF8", "#B8955A", "#10B981", "#F43F5E", "#60A5FA", "#D9C29A", "#2DD4BF")

theme_jbz_cv <- function(base_size = 12) {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.background   = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#0B1B33", colour = NA),
      panel.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#102342", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.major  = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "#1E3A5F", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.minor  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      text              = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#FFFFFF"),
      axis.text         = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#C7D2E3"),
      axis.title        = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#D9C29A", face = "bold"),
      plot.title        = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#FFFFFF", face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle     = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#C7D2E3"),
      legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#0B1B33", colour = NA),
      legend.text       = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#FFFFFF")
    )
}

jbz_plotly_cv <- function(p) {
  plotly::layout(
    p,
    paper_bgcolor = "#0B1B33",
    plot_bgcolor  = "#102342",
    font  = list(color = "#FFFFFF", family = "Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, sans-serif"),
    xaxis = list(gridcolor = "rgba(199,210,227,0.14)", tickfont = list(color = "#C7D2E3")),
    yaxis = list(gridcolor = "rgba(199,210,227,0.14)", tickfont = list(color = "#C7D2E3"))
  )
}
```

## 1. Descarga de Activos y Series de Precios Ajustados

```{r precios}
# 1. Descarga de precios ajustados para la cesta S&P 500 (MSFT, JNJ, MA, PEP, WMT, MCD)
tickers <- c("MSFT", "JNJ", "MA", "PEP", "WMT", "MCD")
basket_prices <- tidyquant::tq_get(
  tickers,
  get  = "stock.prices",
  from = "2008-01-01",
  to   = "2020-09-30"
) %>% dplyr::rename(ticker = symbol)

p_precios <- basket_prices %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = adjusted, color = ticker)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = jbz_series_colors) +
  theme_jbz_cv() +
  labs(title = "Precios Ajustados de la Cesta Corporativa S&P 500", x = "Fecha", y = "USD")

jbz_plotly_cv(plotly::ggplotly(p_precios))
```

## 2. Estacionariedad (ADF) y Selección de Rezagos VAR(p)

```{r estacionariedad}
# 2. Retornos logarítmicos estacionarios I(0) y matriz multivariante
ret_wide <- basket_prices %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ticker) %>%
  tidyquant::tq_transmute(select = adjusted, mutate_fun = periodReturn, period = "daily", type = "log") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ticker, values_from = daily.returns) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

# Verificación formal de estacionariedad (Augmented Dickey-Fuller sin deriva significativa)
adf_resumen <- purrr::map_dfr(tickers, function(sym) {
  test_adf <- urca::ur.df(ret_wide[[sym]], type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")
  tibble::tibble(Activo = sym, Estadistico_tau = round(test_adf@teststat[1], 3), Crit_1pct = test_adf@cval[1, 1])
})
knitr::kable(adf_resumen, caption = "Diagnóstico de Raíces Unitarias ADF sobre Retornos Diarios")
```

```{r seleccion_var}
# 3. Selección de orden de rezagos (AIC / HQ / SC / FPE) y estimación VAR(p)
ret_mat <- ret_wide %>% dplyr::select(-date) %>% as.data.frame()
lag_sel <- vars::VARselect(ret_mat, lag.max = 10, type = "const")
p_opt   <- as.integer(lag_sel$selection[["AIC(n)"]])

var_fit <- vars::VAR(ret_mat, p = p_opt, type = "const")
max_root <- max(vars::roots(var_fit, modulus = TRUE))
cat("Orden óptimo AIC:", p_opt, "| Máx. raíz característica:", round(max_root, 4), "(< 1 => Estable)\n")
```

## 3. Diagnóstico Residual, Granger, IRF y FEVD

```{r diagnosticos}
# 4. Diagnóstico estadístico de residuos (Portmanteau serial.test y ARCH multivariante)
serial_chk <- vars::serial.test(var_fit, lags.pt = 16, type = "PT.asymptotic")
arch_chk   <- vars::arch.test(var_fit, lags.multi = 5)
list(Portmanteau_p = serial_chk$serial$p.value, ARCH_p = arch_chk$arch.mul$p.value)
```

```{r inferencia_dinamica}
# 5. Causalidad de Granger e Impulso-Respuesta Ortogonalizada (Cholesky IRF)
granger_msft <- vars::causality(var_fit, cause = "MSFT")
print(granger_msft$Granger)

irf_msft_ma <- vars::irf(
  var_fit,
  impulse  = "MSFT",
  response = "MA",
  n.ahead  = 15,
  boot     = TRUE,
  ci       = 0.95,
  runs     = 200
)

# Descomposición de Varianza del Error de Pronóstico (FEVD a 10 sesiones)
fevd_10 <- vars::fevd(var_fit, n.ahead = 10)
round(fevd_10$MA * 100, 2)
```

## 4. Estrategia Táctica Rolling VAR Dollar-Neutral

```{r rolling_backtest}
# 6. Estrategia Rolling Out-of-Sample basada en señales VAR(p) (ventanas 250–1000 días)
wdw <- 500L
n_obs <- nrow(ret_wide)
dollar_wgts <- vector("list", n_obs - wdw)

for (i in seq(wdw, n_obs - 1L)) {
  sub_df <- ret_wide %>% dplyr::slice((i - wdw + 1L):i) %>% dplyr::select(-date)
  m_roll <- vars::VAR(sub_df, p = 1L, type = "const")
  fcst   <- sapply(stats::predict(m_roll, n.ahead = 1L)$fcst, function(x) x[1L, "fcst"])
  denom  <- sum(abs(fcst - mean(fcst)))
  dollar_wgts[[i - wdw + 1L]] <- if (denom > 0) (fcst - mean(fcst)) / denom else rep(0, length(fcst))
}

wgts_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(dollar_wgts, function(w) as.data.frame(t(w))))
port_ret <- tibble::tibble(
  date    = ret_wide$date[(wdw + 1L):n_obs],
  ret     = rowSums(wgts_df * ret_wide[(wdw + 1L):n_obs, -1]),
  cum_ret = cumsum(ret)
)

p_cum <- ggplot(port_ret, aes(x = date, y = cum_ret)) +
  geom_line(color = "#B8955A", linewidth = 0.95) +
  theme_jbz_cv() +
  labs(title = "Retorno Acumulado del Sistema Rolling VAR(p) en RStudio", x = "Fecha", y = "Retorno Log Acumulado")
jbz_plotly_cv(ggplotly(p_cum))
```
